payload.description: Provide a reusable, client-neutral AWS infrastructure surface for deploying the complete asynchronous scoring service substrate. Definition of done: network, scoring, integration hosting, scheduled worker hosting, operations, artifact repository, and observability stacks are configurable; consumers supply behavior and configuration; existing legacy deployments remain untouched; immutable score-processor artifacts are deployed exactly as validated.
payload.title: Reusable asynchronous scoring service infrastructure
